 How to watch Oregon vs Michigan State
 Date: Friday, November 20, 2026
 Time: 8 PM EDT
 Channel: FOX
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 No. 13 Oregon is chasing a fourth consecutive win when it travels to face Michigan State on Friday in its final road fixture of the 2026 regular season. The 7-3 Ducks (5-2 in the Big Ten) need to make a statement across their last two games in order to lock down a spot in the College Football Playoffs and have two lay-up fixtures against the Spartans and Rutgers to do just that.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Dan Lanning's side travel to Spartan Stadium after thumping Michigan 31-7 to climb three spots in the CFP rankings and move ever closer to attaining a coveted top-12 spot in the final reckoning. Meanwhile, 3-7 Michigan State (1-6 in the Big Ten) just surrendered 21-14 at home to Washington and is playing purely for pride at this point.
 MSU has also been affected by the recent news that starting quarterback Alessio Milivojevic has been ruled out of Friday's clash, along with talismanic defensive lineman Ben Roberts. Senior backup Cam Fancher would be the obvious choice to fill in for Milivojevic, though he too is reportedly questionable after taking some damage in the loss to Washington.
 Scoring was a concern for Oregon in October after averaging just 14 points per game in its meetings with UCLA (L), Nebraska (W) and Illinois (L). However, that average has hit overdrive and kicked back up to 35 points scored per game across its latest three outings against Northwestern, Ohio State and Michigan.
 Junior quarterback Dylan Raiola has been at the heart of that purple patch and completed on average three touchdowns passes per game during the current win streak. Sophomore running back Dierre Hill Jr. has also figured more prominently in Oregon's plans during that run, scoring three times (two rush, one receiving) in the last two fixtures after going four games without a TD.
